entries.interaction: Search Chinese formal name, pinyin, initials and aliases with 300ms debounce; clear restores the empty-query sections. Single-select Tap Commit + Return. Multi-select toggles and persists while browsing; Return restores the caller with selected species combined by OR. Back first dismisses IME, then exits without a single-select commit; multi-select returns the retained set.
entries.accessibility_rule: Expose the search field, option/group roles, species names and selected state to accessibility services. Preserve logical search→section→option focus order, announce result/empty/error/selection changes, do not trap keyboard or screen-reader focus. Every actionable target meets touch.minimum (44×44dp). Honor OS fontScale; allow names to wrap and rows/cards to grow.

component_contract.shared_visual_core: One shared Selector Core using the approved Species Picker board: full-width search, Recent/Common/All sections for empty query, search-only result state, explicit selected styling, and clear-search empty result. Species images use the registered Fish Knowledge species_id cover. Categories, species information and special cards render only when the cited page authority calls for those fields.
component_contract.shared_geometry_boundary: Recognition Result frozen geometry is authoritative: 320dp Common 2×3 and All one-column; ≥360dp Common 3 columns; row and fish-media dimensions remain those in Species_Selector_Spec_V1. Touch targets are at least geometry.touch.minimum (44×44dp). Page filter shells remain page-owned.

state_model.transitions: Open focuses search only when the caller requests it. Query is debounced 300ms. Single-select tap commits species_id and returns. Multi-select toggles persist while browsing and returns the selected set to F1 with OR semantics. Back dismisses IME first; a single-select cancel leaves the prior caller value unchanged.
